## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle *pìyù*-anthology of some 39 short narratives, compiled (集 *jí*) by the Latter-Qín *bhikṣu* [道略](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E7%95%A5) Dàoluè. Signature: 「比丘道略集」. The opening contents-list enumerates: 「雀離寺師將沙彌下喻、聖王生九百九十九子喻、兄弟二人共為沙門喻、伎兒作種種伎喻、比丘被擯喻、目連與弟子下耆闍崛…」 ("The Sparrow-Departure Monastery's *upādhyāya* with his *śrāmaṇera* parable; the Sage-King with 999 sons parable; the two brothers who became *śramaṇa* together parable…").

**Abstract**

T207 is the third Taishō *Zá pìyù jīng*; see [T204](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0061) for the series-overview. T207 is distinguished by being a *jí* (editorial compilation) rather than a fresh translation: Dàoluè drew on the *pìyù* / *avadāna* material in [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva's translation circle and selected and arranged the narratives. The bracket 405–412 corresponds to Kumārajīva's Cháng'ān period under whose patronage Dàoluè worked. The companion compilation *[T208 Zhòngjīng zhuànzá pìyù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0065)* is also Dàoluè's, with similar editorial method.
